tools.name: list_versions
tools.description:
Returns supported Wallarm Node version lines:
- '5.x' = NGINX Node 5.x / Native Node 0.13.x and below (maintenance)
- '6.x' = NGINX Node 6.x / Native Node 0.14.x – 0.25.x (current stable, default)
- '7.x' = NGINX Node 7.x / Native Node 0.26.x and above (preview)

For each version the response includes status, short description, Native-family Node range, and links to per-version docs landing, what's-new, artifact-versions, and versioning policy. Also returns `legacy_versions_notice` for 4.x and earlier (no longer hosted).

Useful for questions about Wallarm Node versions and their correspondence, and as a prerequisite lookup before answering version-sensitive topics in Wallarm API Security, Node deployment, TRT, or Passive Detection.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description:
Returns the full list of documentation pages (title, URL, section, summary) from the Wallarm AI Control Platform docs.

By default returns pages from the current stable docs version. The optional `wallarm_node_version` parameter targets an earlier (5.x, maintenance) or preview (7.x) version instead. Version matters mainly for Wallarm API Security docs because Node is its core component — installed in the user's infrastructure or on Wallarm-managed Security Edge to analyze and filter incoming traffic. The other three Wallarm AI Control Platform products (AI Hypervisor, Infrastructure Discovery, API Security Testing) have docs that are the same across versions.

The optional `section` parameter narrows the listing to pages whose section name contains the given substring (e.g. 'Kubernetes' returns only K8s-related pages). For keyword search across pages, use `search_pages`.

wallarm_node_version.description: Optional. Wallarm Node version line. '5.x' = NGINX Node 5.x / Native Node 0.13.x and below (maintenance). '6.x' = NGINX Node 6.x / Native Node 0.14.x – 0.25.x (current stable). '7.x' = NGINX Node 7.x / Native Node 0.26.x and above (preview). Defaults to '6.x' if omitted.

tools.name: search_pages
tools.description:
Searches the Wallarm AI Control Platform documentation by keywords and returns the top-N most relevant pages (title, URL, section, summary, relevance score). Ranking weighs title matches highest, then section, then summary — all over the curated `llms.txt` index. Covers the entire platform (all four products), so use for ANY Wallarm-specific question.

By default searches the current stable docs version. The optional `wallarm_node_version` parameter targets an earlier (5.x, maintenance) or preview (7.x) version instead. Version matters mainly for Wallarm API Security topics, since features evolve between Node releases. The other three platform products (AI Hypervisor, Infrastructure Discovery, API Security Testing) are version-agnostic.

query.description: Search keywords, close to the user's wording (e.g. 'rotate API token', 'install on Kubernetes', 'AI agent discovery'). REQUIRED.

wallarm_node_version.description: Optional. Wallarm Node version line. '5.x' = NGINX Node 5.x / Native Node 0.13.x and below (maintenance). '6.x' = NGINX Node 6.x / Native Node 0.14.x – 0.25.x (current stable). '7.x' = NGINX Node 7.x / Native Node 0.26.x and above (preview). Defaults to '6.x' if omitted.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Returns the full markdown content of one Wallarm documentation page by URL. Useful when you already know the exact page you need (e.g. from a previous `search_pages` or `list_pages` call, or a URL the user pasted). The URL must be on docs.wallarm.com, must end in `.md`, and must use the correct version-prefix convention: 5.x and 7.x pages live under `/5.x/` and `/7.x/`; 6.x lives at the docs root with NO `/6.x/` prefix (passing `/6.x/...` is an error). 4.x is no longer hosted.

url.description: Full URL of the page (must end in .md)
